verdict.why: Right includes more of the brief's features: X-braced white trim on the doors, a hoist beam with a hay loft door, a cupola with a weather vane, hay bales, a fence and a grassy base. Left is a plain red box with a dark roof and has no cupola, hoist or hay. Right's gambrel roof is only loosely gambrel, and the checkerboard front looks odd, but it is still richer and more finished than Left.
